Run non-neural, real-world-inspired AVM shotgun against the frozen ensemble.
The 2025-08 to 2025-10 audit is already inspected historical development data:
this screen may guide engineering, but cannot be reported as untouched
confirmation. The existing ensemble is READ ONLY and never refitted. Examples
(PowerShell, project root): py -3.13 avm_realworld_shotgun.py py -3.13
avm_realworld_shotgun.py --full --features baseline rw_adjusted_comps
rw_combined Low-cost screen defaults to 10k historical rows / 220 trees / 350
homes per month. --full uses eligible full history / 700 trees / every holdout
home. Both compare on *identically aligned homes*, but the pilot candidate
models use a lower budget than the frozen ensemble: do not equate their
capacities.

usage: comparable_benchmark.py [-h] [--backend {xgboost,lightgbm,catboost}]
                               [--track {off_market,list_aware}]
                               [--months MONTHS [MONTHS ...]]
                               [--variants {baseline,age_first,type_quota,both} [{baseline,age_first,type_quota,both} ...]]
                               [--text-feature TEXT_FEATURE] --params PARAMS
                               [--output-dir OUTPUT_DIR]

Controlled comparable-sale selection ablation, with no changes to model
defaults. Four variants use the SAME model/feature hyperparameters: baseline -
nearest 128 geographically; age filter; weighted top 32 age_first - eligible
age window FIRST, then nearest 128 type_quota - baseline search + up to 8
guaranteed same-type neighbors both - age-first + same-type quota Runs on
earlier (before December 2025) chronological development folds by default.
December 2025-May 2026 confirmation remains in model_run.ipynb. The results
are exploratory and are not automatically written to logs.md.

Final targeted LIST-AWARE MAE feature ablation against the frozen 50/35/15
winner. This is a RESEARCH comparison on already-inspected Aug--Oct 2025
homes, not an independent holdout or a new production model. Requires an
EXISTING full-strength, single-fit fixed-origin run under
outputs/listaware_fixed_origin_full. Train only three previously untested
CatBoost MAE feature configurations on the exact pre-Aug-2025 cohort; reuse
all previous candidate predictions. Then replace ONLY the 50% MAE member in
the earlier geometric blend, keeping the XGBoost/LightGBM members and blend
weights unchanged. From the repository root: uv run python
listaware_final_mae_features.py Output is resumable under
outputs/listaware_final_mae_features. Existing models, factories, snapshots
and fixed-origin outputs are read-only.

Quick, leak-safe OFF-MARKET cross-family blending experiment. The frozen
XGBoost ensemble reference is NEVER retrained or overwritten. Fit standalone
tuned XGBoost, CatBoost and LightGBM off-market regressors on COMPLETED past
sales, evaluate the SAME IDs as the frozen 2025 shadow audit, and test
PREDECLARED geometric blends anchored separately on standalone XGB and on the
already-frozen ensemble. For a fast proof of concept: python
offmarket_crossfamily_blend.py --reuse-family-caches
outputs/offmarket_crossfamily_pilot For all eligible prior training sales with
recorded tuned iteration counts: python offmarket_crossfamily_blend.py --full
No list_price, test labels, or in-sample predictions are model features. Pilot
challengers use less compute than the frozen ensemble; do NOT treat this as a
matched-training-budget test of independent model family superiority.

Fast, chronological shotgun screen for spatiotemporal XGBoost improvements.
The FEATURE arm retrains XGBoost on the same reduced training sample while
adding one feature family at a time. The RESIDUAL arm trains lightweight
space-time corrections on genuine previous-month out-of-time predictions of
the baseline model. Both arms score the SAME untouched development cohort.
This is deliberately exploratory. Screening performance is not directly
comparable to the 7.82% full-history, 700-tree benchmark. After selecting a
few contenders, rerun them with the complete training history and the existing
final/fixed-origin validation procedures. Example: uv run python
spacetime_shotgun.py --validation-month 2025-10

Three-month chronological follow-up for leading space-time XGBoost candidates.
This runner REUSES spacetime_shotgun.run_shotgun without changing production
features or targets, runs three larger chronological folds, and pools exactly
matched properties. Every month has a separate output folder; successful,
parameter-matched months may be resumed without retraining. Defaults:
September, October, November 2025; all homes in each validation month; 40k
sampled historical rows per fold; 500 tuned XGBoost trees; 3 prior OOT
calibration months; 1,200 calibration homes per month. This is DEVELOPMENT
research, not untouched confirmation: the October 2025 fold was already
inspected during the shotgun screen. Prefer stability across months and paired
differences rather than treating small pooled wins as proof. From the
repository root: uv run python spacetime_three_month.py uv run python
spacetime_three_month.py --train-cap 60000 --trees 700 Outputs in
outputs/spacetime_three_month, plus one subfolder per month.
